message: I'm on an island in the middle of a river! Majuli sits midstream in the mighty Brahmaputra and stretches about 80 km. The river keeps reshaping it, and little islets called chaporis form all around.

field_find.name: Sattras
field_find.note: About 30 sattras, centres where villages gather for festivals and culture.

alt: A long green river island with thatched roofs, a ferry crossing the wide brown river.

sources.title: River Island of Majuli in midstream of Brahmaputra River in Assam, UNESCO World Heritage Tentative List
sources.supports: Island midstream in the Brahmaputra; about 80 km long; floods carry silt; islets called chaporis; about 30 sattras as cultural centres

review.notes: Coordinates are approximate (island centre); the source page gives none.
